verdict.rationale: macOS's 'switching' documentation is about migrating data/files from an old Windows PC to a new physical Mac (via Migration Assistant), not about installing macOS in place of the existing OS on the same hardware — Apple does not support installing macOS as a replacement OS on non-Apple PCs. No evidence in the pack shows dual-boot, in-place OS replacement, or bare-metal installation on the switcher's own current machine.
